prompt:
Style: blueprint-cyanotype. Transform the supplied ORIGINAL photograph of a LEGO Millennium Falcon model on a white cabinet, minifigures, a display plaque and nearby autumn foliage. Render only a single full-frame artwork using this style treatment:

The artwork reinterprets the photo's actual content as a handmade cyanotype print on visibly textured flat paper: deep Prussian blue as the exposed-paper ground, and the main subject — plus only those environmental elements genuinely belonging to the scene — appearing in luminous pale ivory, as if exposed by light. The method is editing, reduction, extraction, simplification and reconstruction: keep the strongest structures, most recognizable silhouettes, essential gestures and spatial relationships, with generous negative space. A strict exclusion defines this prompt: no fixed botanical template — never add decorative ferns, wildflowers, branches, grasses, leaves, botanical borders or plant silhouettes to fill space; plants appear only if genuinely present in the original, and nothing may be invented. The cyanotype character must be physical: paper fibers, subtly imperfect contact-print edges, nuanced blue variation, localized uneven exposure, faint chemical processing marks — not a digital illustration or a simple blue filter. 

Preserve the original scene's subject relationships. Every part of the canvas must belong to the transformed artwork. No original photo panel, no before/after comparison, no split, no text.
